prerequisite: E2C-R2 reduced R1 bracket failures from 196 to 28 but did not reach zero
purpose: Characterize whether the 28 residual endpoint failures can be covered by a material-independent fixed endpoint-clustering exponent without changing broad-path segmentation, quadrature lane count, root iteration bound or acceptance thresholds.
required_reports: relative reference root gap to K(h_above)
nearest first-segment lane distance from h_above for each exponent
whether each exponent restores a sign-changing bracket
fraction and count restored per exponent
smallest exponent that restores each failure if any
hard_guards: This diagnostic cannot qualify any candidate.
R2 remains FAIL regardless of diagnostic outcome.
No exponent outside the frozen set may be introduced after seeing results in this diagnostic.
No lane count, broad-path segmentation, threshold or material-specific policy may change.
